name: playwright-fast
description: Persistent, contract-driven Playwright automation for low-latency Codex browser work.

interface.shortDescription: Run browser flows through a persistent Chromium runtime.
interface.longDescription: Exposes run, reset, and status tools backed by a reusable Playwright browser. Includes compact contracts and evidence, persistent storage, local adaptive routing through inherited HTTP/HTTPS proxies, WS/WSS-aware proxy selection, and context-owned HTTP connection pools. Optional delayed connection competition stays disabled by default.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run this browser flow with one compact Playwright Fast contract.
